title: A Linearized Obstruction to the Supersymmetric Extension of Conformal Boundary Conditions in Euclidean Gravity
summary: The conformal boundary condition for gravity fixes the boundary conformal class and the mean curvature, leaving the trace-free extrinsic curvature free as the conjugate response. It is the boundary-value form of York's conformal decomposition of gravitational data, shown to be well posed for Einstein metrics by Anderson. Witten identified it as the elliptic replacement for the ill-posed Dirichlet condition in the finite-boundary perturbative Euclidean gravitational path integral.
